propositions: Completion verifier blocks closing tickets whose acceptance criteria have been invalidated by the fix itself or are auto-generated and unverifiable, with no documented legitimate path forward.
Current workarounds (--force-close or --ref to old commits) leave inaccurate state in the ticket system by closing against criteria that no longer hold in the current codebase.
The --ref flag provides a legitimate close path for criteria invalidated by subsequent commits after the work landed, but this mechanism is undocumented in the close workflow.
Tickets with criteria altered by the fix itself have no commit reference where both the fix is present and the original criteria remain satisfiable.
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces re-review of already-executed work when criteria registry changes since plan sign-off, blocking otherwise-complete ticket closure.
